title: Actual RibaMod active-river reciprocal stage-feedback bridge

sequencing.rationale: Freeze the first bidirectional physical RibaMod experiment before observing the two-day management-memory result.

purpose: Qualify the active RibaMod river path as a reciprocal physical bridge: accepted Ribasim Basin/subgrid level is applied as MF6 river stage, MF6 computes river exchange, and the reciprocal positive flux is applied back to Ribasim as infiltration.

modflow.active_mapping: Basin index 0 / RIV bound index 0 / subgrid index 0

derivation: For each 6 h product interval, RibaMod samples the accepted Ribasim subgrid level at the interval start and writes it to the MF6 active river stage.
With intercell conductance K=1e6 and river conductance C=16, the near-steady active-cell river flux is q = C*K/(K+C)*(stage-0.5).
That MF6 flux is held as Ribasim infiltration over the subsequent 6 h Ribasim physical step.
Basin area is constant at 1e6 m2, so h_next = h_start - q*(0.25 day)/A.

hypotheses: At each product-step start, the active MF6 river stage equals the accepted Ribasim subgrid level from the preceding boundary.
MF6 river flux is positive into the aquifer and approximately follows the frozen conductance relation.
RibaMod maps that positive active-river flux to positive Ribasim Basin infiltration and zero drainage.
The Basin level decreases monotonically according to the frozen 6-hour sample-and-hold reference.
Cumulative Ribasim infiltration equals Basin storage loss within tolerance because no other source, sink or managed demand is active.
The active-river exchange is reciprocal at every accepted boundary: integrated MF6 river transfer equals cumulative Ribasim infiltration within tolerance.
The experiment exposes the product's staggered time direction explicitly: accepted Ribasim stage -> MF6 solve -> reciprocal flux -> next Ribasim state.
